(60 [[Museum]] donations) |sellprice = N/A }} The '''Rusty Key''' is used to enter [[the Sewers]]. It is obtained from [[Gunther]] in a cutscene the morning after 60 items have been donated to the [[Museum]]. During the cutscene, Gunther greets the player at their front door, thanks them for their contributions to the museum, and gives them the Rusty Key. In [[Multiplayer]], the host must speak with Gunther to get the key. Its existence is first referenced by [[Jas]] and [[Vincent]] in a cutscene in [[Cindersap Forest]]. This cutscene triggers on or after Spring 11 of Year 1 by entering the Forest between 9am and 4pm on a Monday, Thursday, or Sunday. Once obtained, it can be found in [[the Player]]'s Menu on the [[Special Items & Powers]] tab. ==History== {{History|1.0|Introduced.}} {{History|1.6|Now located in the new Special Items & Powers tab instead of the player's wallet.}} [[Category:Special items]] [[de:Rostiger Schlüssel]] [[es:Llave oxidada]] [[fr:Clé rouillée]] [[it:Chiave arrugginita]] [[ja:錆びた鍵]] [[ko:녹슨 열쇠]] [[hu:Rozsdás kulcs]] [[pt:Chave Enferrujada]] [[ru:Ржавый ключ]] [[tr:Paslı Anahtar]] [[zh:生锈的钥匙]]
